We are hiring a Manager, Cloud Platform Engineers to lead our India-based platform and automation engineering staff. This is a people-management role with real technical ownership -- you will be evaluated as much on your ability to review and stand behind your team's Kubernetes and Terraform work as on how you manage the people producing it. You will oversee day-to-day execution of AKS operations and Terraform-based automation, working in close coordination with the US-based Principal and Expert Platform Engineers who set the platform's architectural direction.
This role exists to provide direct, hands-on management and accurate technical oversight of the India-based team -- including work planning, prioritization, quality review, and status reporting to the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform. Reporting must reflect verified, actual system state; this is a core expectation of the role, not a formality.

What You'll Do

• Directly manage India-based Cloud Platform engineers, including workload assignment, prioritization, and day-to-day people management.

• Review and stand behind your team's Terraform module submissions and AKS configuration changes for correctness, adherence to documented standards, and production-readiness before they are considered complete.

• Enforce engineering process standards across the team: issue-based work tracking, triage and prioritization before work begins, work-in-progress limits, and daily status updates.

• Provide the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform with accurate, verified status reporting on the India-based team's work -- cross-checked against actual system and repository state, not summarized from memory or secondhand updates.

• Coordinate with the Principal and Expert Platform Engineers on platform architecture and standards, ensuring the India-based team's work aligns with the broader platform's GitOps, Terraform, and AKS conventions.

• Escalate technical or delivery risks early and directly, rather than allowing status to be discovered after the fact.

• Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development for the India-based team, including closing gaps in Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD fundamentals where needed.

• Apply policy-as-code and security standards already established on the platform (Kyverno or equivalent) when reviewing team output.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, including some prior people-management or formal technical-lead experience.

• Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes, ideally AKS specifically -- sufficient to personally review a team member's cluster or workload change and identify problems.

• Working Terraform experience, including the ability to review a submitted module for correctness, reusability, and adherence to documented standards.

• GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) -- all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference.

• Demonstrated ability to produce accurate, verifiable status reporting to senior leadership.

• Experience managing engineers directly, including performance management, prioritization, and workload planning.

• Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent).

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience managing a distributed or offshore engineering team reporting to a manager in a different region.

• Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work.

• Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent).

• Background modernizing legacy automation (PowerShell or similar) toward Terraform or platform-native replacements.

title: Software Engineer, Storage Systems (Agent Infra)
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Storage decides how fast agent sandboxes start and how safely they share data. Agents need a filesystem that thousands of sandboxes mount at the same time, with strict isolation and the consistency agents need. Agent context is mostly small files, so the access patterns look very different from storage built for large files.

The Agent Infra team builds Agent Drive, the distributed filesystem that agent sandboxes mount over FUSE, and the storage underneath it. The work uses tiered caching, replication, content-addressed data, and Linux filesystem internals. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose sandboxes and Agent Drive filesystem are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes.

We are building a cloud, not just using one, so storage is designed for many tenants from day one. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs.

If you care about page cache coherency, FUSE, replication protocols, and content-addressable storage, we'd love to talk.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

- Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/

- Baseten Sandboxes documentation https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and implement core Agent Drive features: metadata replication, volume placement, garbage collection, and FUSE client behavior

- Solve multi-attach correctness: cache coherency across many FUSE mounts of the same drive, dentry and inode invalidation, write ordering, and crash consistency

- Optimize tail latency on read and write paths, including page cache strategy, writeback, prefetch, and metadata RPC batching

- Build tenant isolation into the storage layer, including quota enforcement, blast-radius containment, and noisy-neighbor mitigation

- Own the storage side of sandbox startup and resume performance

- Build durable block storage for sandboxes alongside other Baseten storage teams

- Build observability into every layer, drive storage incidents end to end, and turn each one into a permanent fix

- Contribute upstream to the open-source storage projects we build on

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong systems programming background in Go, Rust, and/or C/C++, with comfort reading kernel code

- Deep understanding of Linux filesystem and storage internals: VFS, page cache, dentry and inode caches, FUSE, the block I/O stack, fsync semantics, and crash consistency

- Hands-on experience building distributed storage systems, content-addressable storage, or large-scale caching infrastructure

- Experience profiling I/O, memory, and RPC bottlenecks and optimizing tail latency in production

- Ability to debug correctness bugs that only show up under concurrency or partial failure

- You move fast and like owning a problem end to end on a small team

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with a distributed filesystem or object store such as JuiceFS, CephFS, or S3-compatible storage, or contributions to those projects

- Knowledge of consensus and replication protocols (Raft, leader leases, quorum reads)

- Experience with snapshot, clone, and copy-on-write filesystem features
